text:
rachel (pm): Quick thread: I want a precision-slice canary playbook we can run next quarter. Objective: let targeted tenants test the low-bit routing with minimal blast radius and clear automated reasons for any diversion. Short proposal below, please react.

rachel (pm): Phases:
- mirror-alpha: internal mirror 0.5% for 8h with synthetic probes.
- opt-in-micro: up to 12 tenants, max 0.5% global, A/B 50/50, 3h bake then 12h observe.
- stratum-scale: widen to 60 tenants, 5% global, A/B 70/30, 24h observe per stratum.
- geo-slice: region slices (EU/US/APAC) 10% each only if quality gates pass.
- slow-roll GA: token budget caps and 7d observation.

liam (eng): Implementation notes: flags must support per-tenant + per-stratum targeting (prompt_length, tenant_size). Add reason_code enum for any auto-divert. Controller enforces min_sample_count and min_time_window before percent increases.

priya (sre): Circuit breaker rules (draft): auto-divert tenant if:
- p95 > baseline * 2 for 5m OR
- absolute error rate increase > 0.4% for 10m OR
- GPU preemptions observed.
Region auto-divert requires 3 independent tenants tripping in 15m. On auto-divert set flag to "auto_divert:<reason>" and page oncall. Manual un-divert only. Cooldown 30m.

emily (data): Metrics & analysis: multilayer checks -> fidelity (embedding cosine mean >= 0.88), infra (p50/p95, error delta), business (CTR delta <= 0.5% abs). For small cohorts use bootstrap CI and require signal stability for 6h before scaling. Use Bayesian sequential testing with min N=1500 impressions or 12h.

nate (cs): CS side: opt-in consent flow + console toggle per-tenant. Add "auto-divert preference" (auto/manual) in consent. Show reason_code and brief explanation in tenant UI when divert happens.

rachel (pm): Flag schema example (string): {"name":"prod.ff.routing.precision.slice","envs":"[\"staging\",\"prod\"]","default":"false","allowed_tenants":"[\"acct_test\"]","strata":"[\"prompt_short\",\"prompt_long\"]","min_sample_count":"1500","min_time_window_mins":"60","warmup_rps_per_tenant":"15","dry_warm":"true","owner":"rachel"}" , keep as simple strings for infra parsing.

liam (eng): We'll add a rollout-controller that emits stop reasons and can flip flags via API. Also adding a dry_warm path for non-billing cache priming and a smoke generator that emits stratified traffic.

priya (sre): Warmup policy: default 15 rps per tenant with exponential backoff. Throttle metrics emitted. Add rate-limited KV cache prefill to avoid thundering herd.

emily (data): Reporting: provide per-stratum panels (latency, cosine, CTR) and a 6h quick-check + 24h detailed report. Auto-alert if effect size > 0.02 on core metrics.

nate (cs): I'll draft consent UI text + rollback email templates and CS playbook. Include a visible "why we diverted" card in tenant console.

rachel (pm): Actions & ETAs:
- liam: controller + dry_warm + flag support for strata (ETA Thu)
- emily: gating doc + dashboard panels (ETA Wed)
- priya: circuit breaker + warmup throttles (ETA Fri)
- nate: consent + tenant UI + templates (ETA Mon)

flag-bot: Created flag prod.ff.routing.precision.slice in staging at 2067890123.

rachel (pm): If no objections by EOD I'll schedule mirror-alpha next Tue and open PRs. Quick :thumbsup: to ack.

liam (eng): ack.

priya (sre): ack.

emily (data): ack.

nate (cs): ack, will prep CS notes.
